_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: FOUR LEVELS CHECKED, FOUR CLEAR, AND THE POSITION MADE A NEW LOW FOR THE DAY WHILE DOING IT - all three clauses belong in the same sentence, because a slot that reports only the first one is hiding the second. OKLO is 44.27 bid against a 45.1499 average, so the position is -1.95%, 1.76 of unrealized loss on a 90.30 cost, against a 54.18 target that needs the bid up 22.4% and a 41.54 stop that needs it down 6.2%. The time stop is the 8/14 close, today session one of five. No option is held, so no no-fly window can apply, and the calendar was re-pulled live rather than carried forward - 934 earnings events across 8/10 to 8/14, OKLO in none of them, SMCI on 8/11 pm verified at an 0.88 estimate the only watched name inside the window. Nothing was hit, so nothing is proposed. THE STOP IS NOW INSIDE ONE DAY'S RANGE AND THAT IS STATED, NOT ACTED ON. The 41.54 stop sits 6.2% below the bid on a name that has already travelled 8.57% today, which means an ordinary continuation of the session that is already happening reaches it. That is a fact about the distance, not a reason to pre-empt the level: the rulebook exits at the stop, not near it, and selling at -1.95% because -8% looks reachable is a stop moved by nerves in the direction that feels prudent. It is written down here so that if the level trades this afternoon nobody has to reconstruct whether it was foreseen. THE FINDING IS A DIVERGENCE: THE BOARD STOPPED FALLING AND THE POSITION DID NOT. Breadth improved for the first time today in the honest direction - 9 red of 12 against 10 red at both 11:22 and the open, with RGTI flipping green at +0.4% - and six of the twelve names are bid HIGHER than an hour ago against six lower, dead even where the last hour was nine of twelve lower. Against that stabilising tape OKLO fell from 44.91 to 44.27 and is the worst name on this board for a fourth consecutive read at -8.57%. The complex bounced without it twice today and it has made a lower low each time. Deployable is 919.58 settled with nothing pending. NO NEW ORDER IN THE ACCOUNT SINCE THE 10:39 FILL, queried directly rather than inferred: one order exists in this account since 8/7, the OKLO buy filled 10:39:30 ET at 45.1499 on a 45.40 limit, placed_agent agentic, with no specification from any run here behind it. The escalation is carried a third hour unchanged and uncompounded. Against the 2026-08-10 concentration rule the book is one name of four, 8.8% of account value at the bid against a 40% single-name ceiling, and one of the two the nuclear complex allows.
account.priorNote: ONE POSITION, FOUR LEVELS, ALL FOUR CLEAR - and that sentence is the whole of what this slot is for. OKLO is 44.91 bid against a 45.1499 average, so the position is -0.53%, roughly half a percent below cost with the 54.18 target 20.6% above the bid and the 41.54 stop 7.5% below it. The time stop is the 8/14 close with today session one of five. No option is held, so no no-fly window can apply, and the earnings calendar was re-pulled live rather than carried forward - 910 events across 8/10 to 8/14 and OKLO appears in none of them, so the 8/7 print is behind the position rather than inside it and the only watched name reporting in the window is SMCI tomorrow evening. Nothing was due, so nothing was proposed. NO NEW ORDER IN THE ACCOUNT SINCE THE 10:39 FILL. The order record was queried directly rather than inferred from the balance: one order exists in this account since 8/7, the OKLO buy filled 10:39:30 ET at 45.1499 on a 45.40 limit, placed_agent agentic. So the escalation the 10:46 sync raised stands exactly where it stood - no run in this project published that specification - and it has not compounded this hour. It is carried, not re-argued. THE BOUNCE THE 10:22 HOURLY REFUSED TO CALL A BOTTOM HAS BEEN GIVEN BACK. Breadth is 10 red of 12 against 8 red an hour ago, which puts it back where the open read it, and nine of the twelve names are bid lower than at 10:22. The two marginal greens flipped: QBTS from +0.05% to -1.20%, LEU from +0.07% to -0.71%. The two real greens gave back a third to two-thirds of what they held: SMCI +5.7% to +3.7%, JOBY +4.7% to +1.6%. That vindicates the 10:22 reading that forty minutes of less-bad is not a session of having stopped - and the same honesty requires the next sentence. BOTH OF THAT RUN'S TELLS INVERTED WITHIN THE HOUR. It named SOUN, still falling while its complex bounced, as the cleanest evidence the give-back was unfinished, and UPST, flat while eleven names lifted, as the other. SOUN and UPST are two of the only three names bid HIGHER than at 10:22. The conclusion held and the two pieces of evidence offered for it did not, which is worth writing down because a read that is right for reasons that stop being true is a read that got lucky about its reasoning. Deployable is 919.58 settled with nothing pending. Against the 2026-08-10 concentration rule the book is one name of four, 8.9% of account value at the bid against a 40% single-name ceiling, and one of two permitted in the nuclear complex.
account.operatorNote: OPERATOR, 2026-08-10, answering the funding escalation carried in the notes above rather than editing either of them. The 900.00 is a deposit I made; the account is funded to about 1000 and the cash is spendable. This answers the deposit and NOTHING ELSE - it is not an authorisation for the OKLO order the 10:46 sync found, which no run here published and which arrived through the same agentic channel escalated on 8/7; that escalation stands open and unanswered. Three rule changes go with it and all three are written up in docs/RULES.md with their arithmetic, because a licence recorded without its constraints is how this record stops being worth reading. The position ceiling goes from two to four, capped at 40% in any one name and at two names in any one complex - the complex cap is the one that matters on a board whose whole universe moves together. Overnight holds are not a change: they were always allowed, the five-session time stop stands, and it is not extendable by conviction. The objective is still about 10% a day, which is roughly 101 dollars at this size and needs a fully deployed four-name book to average +10% in a session against a +20% take-profit; where the objective and the rulebook conflict, the rulebook wins and the retro records the shortfall. What the deposit does NOT do is reopen options - that refusal has been on spread for three sessions, most recently 36% of mark against a 10% ceiling, and no balance narrows a spread. The 10:22 hourly was right to escalate this rather than size against it.
account.openingNote: THIS IS THE OPENING READ AND THE DAILY ENTRY MANDATE IS DISCHARGED, forced on item 1: buy 12 JOBY at a 8.85 limit, target 10.62, stop 8.14, time stop the 8/14 close, expiring 10:30 ET. Exits were checked before entries and there was nothing to check - a flat book means no target, no stop, no time stop and no option expiry no-fly window was due, and none went unenforced. Two things this run settled that were handed to it by name. FIRST, the straddle Friday's pre-close owed to this slot was pulled: the SMCI 8/14 32 call marks 2.51 against a 2.05 put, a 4.56 straddle on a 32.21 spot, so the market prices a 14.2% move on tomorrow night's print. SMCI is refused on that arithmetic and not on a view - the rulebook stops equity at -8%, and an 8% stop sits entirely inside a 14.2% expected move, so the realistic bad case gaps through the stop rather than filling at it and the exit written before entry would not be the exit taken. That matters beyond the refusal, because SMCI was the ONLY name on this board with a forward catalyst, and once it is gone item 1 cannot be passed anywhere on the list. SECOND, options were priced before any thesis was built, as the 8/5 rule requires, and are refused for a third consecutive session on SPREAD rather than affordability: eight contracts quoted live across JOBY, SOUN and SMR at 3-6 weeks, every one clearing the 0.40 delta floor, several affordable outright, and the tightest of them at 36% of mark against a 10% ceiling. Three different cash balances - 128.90, 126.06 and now 109.88 - have produced the same answer, which is the point at which it stops being about the balance. The tape reversed wholesale over the weekend: breadth is 10 RED of 12 after six consecutive 10-green reads on Friday, and the names that extended hardest into Friday's bell are the ones being unwound hardest now. JOBY is one of two green names and the only green one without a print tomorrow. That is the entry, and it is also exactly what is wrong with it - relative strength on a red tape is a real condition and it is not a catalyst, so item 1 is marked fail and the entry is published forced rather than dressed up as something cleaner.

positions.note: EVERY LEVEL CHECKED AGAINST THE 12:22 BID AND EVERY LEVEL CLEAR, which remains the only claim this slot is entitled to make. Target 54.18 needs the 44.27 bid up 22.4%; the 41.54 stop needs it down 6.2%; the position is -1.95% on the bid, 1.76 of unrealized loss on a 90.30 cost; the time stop is the 8/14 close with today session one of five. No-fly re-pulled live rather than carried: 934 earnings events across 8/10 to 8/14 with OKLO in none of them, and no option is held for the window to bite on in any case. WHAT CHANGED THIS HOUR IS THE DISTANCE, NOT THE DECISION. At 11:22 the stop was 7.5% away; it is 6.2% away now, on a name that has already covered 8.57% of ground today. A stop that sits inside a single session's realised range is a stop that an ordinary continuation reaches, and that is worth writing down in advance so that nobody has to reconstruct this afternoon whether it was seen coming. It is not a reason to sell at -1.95%. Exiting early because the stop looks reachable is the stop being moved by nerves, in the direction that happens to feel prudent, and the rulebook exits AT the level. THE DIVERGENCE IS THE REST OF IT. Breadth improved to 9 red of 12 from 10 red, six of the twelve names are bid higher than an hour ago, and OKLO went the other way to a new low for the day. It is the worst name on this board for a fourth consecutive read and it has now declined to participate in two separate intraday bounces. That is information about the name rather than about the tape, and it belongs on the record before the level is reached rather than after. Everything already said about the entry stands: this is the name the 10:22 candidate row refused under item 2 as day one of a decline, and the fill sits within a nickel of the bid at which it was refused. Provenance is unchanged and unresolved - one order in this account since 8/7, tagged to the agentic channel, no specification from any run here behind it, and nothing new in the hundred minutes since. That is the retro's to answer; this slot's job is to enforce the levels on a position that exists, whoever opened it, and the levels are clear. Tagged nuclear, which puts SMR and LEU on the same two-name limit as this position.

entryWatch.setup: JOBY post-earnings continuation - EXPIRED UNEXECUTED, and it is now further below its own limit than an hour ago
entryWatch.trigger: None, and the trigger stays dead in both directions. The 8.85 limit expired at 10:30 ET; JOBY is 8.67 bid, eighteen cents BELOW the level, and re-striking a dead specification is a mid-session entry this slot refuses whether the name is above the limit or under it.
entryWatch.why: THE ROUND TRIP IS NOW A TREND AND IT KEEPS MAKING THE SAME POINT. At 10:22 this board recorded that the forced 8.85 entry would be showing a gain - JOBY was 9.05 bid, 2.3% past the limit. At 11:22 it was 8.78, and the same specification would have been -0.79%. It is 8.67 bid now and that specification would be -2.03%, a third consecutive re-mark and each one worse than the last. Every one of those statements was true when written and not one of them is a rule, which is the entire reason the forced arm is measured separately. What the sequence demonstrates is the ground the 10:22 refusal actually rested on: a name that runs 2.3% past its level in forty minutes can come back through it in sixty and keep going for another hour, so chasing it upward would have been the error rather than the missed opportunity it looked like at the time. JOBY is +0.35% on the day, barely holding green, having been +4.7% at 10:22 - it has given back almost the whole of its advance and is now one of only three green names on a board where green has stopped meaning strength.

entryWatch.setup: SMCI pre-earnings - REFUSED on its own straddle, roughly a day from the print
entryWatch.trigger: None. The 8/14 32-strike straddle prices a 14.2% move on the 8/11 print and an 8% stop cannot survive it. Calendar re-confirmed live at 12:22 against 934 events in the 8/10-8/14 window: 8/11, pm, verified, estimate 0.88, and still the only watched name reporting inside it.
entryWatch.why: Unchanged in arithmetic and almost unchanged in tape - 32.22 bid, +3.5%, against +3.7% an hour ago and +5.7% at 10:22, so the give-back that was steep last hour has flattened out. None of that touches the refusal, which was never about direction. The 8/14 32 call marked 2.51 against a 2.05 put for a 4.56 straddle on a 32.21 spot: a 14.2% implied move against a rulebook stop of 8%. An 8% stop sitting entirely inside a 14.2% expected move is an exit the event is priced to jump rather than fill, which is the sense in which item 3 is a gate and not a formality. Any 3-6 week option necessarily spans the print and is forbidden outright, so the option route was never reachable either. The print is now about twenty-eight hours out and this board holds nothing in it - which is the whole point of having decided at 09:41 rather than at 15:33 tomorrow.

entryWatch.setup: The speculative complex - the first genuine stabilisation of the session, and the account's name is not in it
entryWatch.trigger: No level. Breadth improved to 9 red of 12 from 10 red, RGTI flipped green, and the board is exactly even hour-on-hour at six names higher and six lower against nine lower last hour. That is a tape that has stopped falling for now; it is not a day-2/3 pullback, and one flat hour after two down ones is not a base.
entryWatch.why: THE READ IS NO LONGER ABOUT BREADTH, IT IS ABOUT WHAT BREADTH LEFT BEHIND. Two hours of this board have been a story about the whole list moving together - 10 green of 12 into Friday's bell, 10 red at the open, 8 red then 10 red again. This hour breaks that: the list is split six up and six down, the marginal names are firming, RGTI is green at +0.4%, and IONQ, UPST, QBTS and SOUN are all bid above their 11:22 quotes. Against which OKLO, the one name this account owns, fell 0.64 to a new low for the day and is the worst name on the list for a fourth consecutive read. It has now sat out two separate intraday bounces. When a name declines to participate in its complex's recoveries twice in one session, the correlation argument that justifies watching the complex at all stops covering it, and what is left is a name-specific problem the levels will price in their own time. Nothing here is buyable and nothing is proposed: this slot opens nothing, the bar for a mid-session entry is higher than the open's by design, and a first flat hour is the least informative moment in a decline to decide it has ended. The two nuclear names outside the position are LEU at -1.5% and SMR at -5.5%, and the complex cap would allow exactly one of them.

It led Friday at +13.4% and is still among the worst four names on the day, which is the pattern the whole list is describing: the hardest advances are taking the hardest unwinds.

HELD - see the exit board for its levels. 44.27 bid, -8.57%, a new low for the day, the worst name on this list for a fourth consecutive read and lower than at the open, at 10:22 and at 11:22.
